items.en: APPSC issues Group-II notification for 686 posts; apply from 10 November
items.te: 686 పోస్టులకు APPSC గ్రూప్-II నోటిఫికేషన్; నవంబర్ 10 నుంచి దరఖాస్తులు
points: APPSC released brief Notification No. 37/2026 for Group-II Services on 13 October 2026.
It lists 686 provisional executive and non-executive vacancies, including 200 Deputy Tahsildar posts.
Online applications: 10 to 30 November 2026 on psc.ap.gov.in; the detailed notification is due by 10 November.
The Screening test date is yet to be announced.
items.exam: Group-II Screening: 150 questions on Indian History, Geography, Indian Society, Current Affairs and Mental Ability (30 each). Use the Group 2 study plan in this app.

items.en: AP High Court orders CBI probe into Gade Sai Krishna custodial death case
items.te: గాదె సాయికృష్ణ కస్టడీ మరణం కేసులో సీబీఐ దర్యాప్తుకు ఏపీ హైకోర్టు ఆదేశం
points: On 16 October 2026 the AP High Court transferred the investigation into the alleged custodial death of Gade Sai Krishna to the CBI.
Sai Krishna had been picked up by Krishnalanka police in Vijayawada in May 2026; a State SIT was probing the case.
A circle inspector was earlier arrested and booked on murder and wrongful-confinement charges.
items.exam: Static link: Article 21 protects against custodial torture; D.K. Basu v. State of West Bengal (1997) laid down arrest and detention guidelines. The CBI works under the DSPE Act, 1946.

items.en: PM inaugurates five Ladakh projects worth ₹3,350 crore
items.te: లద్దాఖ్‌లో ₹3,350 కోట్ల విలువైన ఐదు ప్రాజెక్టులను ప్రారంభించిన ప్రధాని
points: On 15 October 2026 PM Narendra Modi inaugurated five projects in Ladakh by video conference.
They include a ₹640 crore passenger terminal at Kushok Bakula Rimpochee Airport, Leh, which uses geothermal energy.
Also: the 298-km Nimmu–Padum–Darcha road built by BRO and the 9 MW Hanu hydroelectric project.
India's first Petroglyph Conservation Park in Leh and 40 water bodies under Project Amrit Him Sarovar complete the list.
items.exam: Static link: Ladakh became a Union Territory without a legislature on 31 October 2019 (J&K Reorganisation Act, 2019); BRO works under the Ministry of Defence.

items.en: National SARAS Mela 2026 opens in Vijayawada, first edition outside Delhi-NCR
items.te: విజయవాడలో జాతీయ సరస్ మేళా 2026 ప్రారంభం — ఢిల్లీ-ఎన్‌సీఆర్ వెలుపల తొలిసారి
points: President Droupadi Murmu inaugurated the mela at Punnami Ghat, Vijayawada, with the Governor and the Chief Minister.
It is the first National SARAS Mela held outside Delhi-NCR and runs till 31 October 2026.
It is organised by the Union Ministry of Rural Development with the AP government's SERP.
Women from self-help groups across 30+ States and UTs are showcasing their products.
items.exam: Static link: SARAS melas come under DAY-NRLM (Ministry of Rural Development); SERP (Society for Elimination of Rural Poverty) is AP's rural livelihoods mission agency.

items.en: International expert panel inspects Polavaram ECRF dam works
items.te: పోలవరం ఈసీఆర్‌ఎఫ్ డ్యామ్ పనులను పరిశీలించిన అంతర్జాతీయ నిపుణుల బృందం
points: An international expert team inspected ongoing Earth-cum-Rock Fill (ECRF) dam construction at the Polavaram Irrigation Project.
It was the team's eighth visit to the project.
The Panel of Experts includes specialists from the USA and Canada, roped in to review the project's dam safety and design.
items.exam: Static link: Polavaram is on the Godavari and was declared a national project under the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014; ECRF = Earth-cum-Rock Fill dam.

items.en: IMF raises India's growth forecast to about 7% in October 2026 WEO
items.te: అక్టోబర్ 2026 డబ్ల్యూఈఓలో భారత వృద్ధి అంచనాను సుమారు 7%కి పెంచిన ఐఎంఎఫ్
points: The IMF's October 2026 World Economic Outlook lifted India's growth projection to about 7%, from 6.4% in its July update.
It cited resilient domestic demand and growing services activity.
Elevated oil prices and global uncertainty were flagged as downside risks.
India stays the fastest-growing major economy in the IMF projections.
items.exam: Static link: the IMF publishes the World Economic Outlook twice a year (April and October) with updates in January and July; the World Bank publishes Global Economic Prospects.

items.en: World Food Day 2026: "Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow."
items.te: ప్రపంచ ఆహార దినోత్సవం 2026: "ఇన్నోవేట్ టుడే. నరిష్ టుమారో."
points: World Food Day is observed on 16 October; the 2026 theme is "Innovate today. Nourish tomorrow."
FAO is marking the 2026 observance in Uzbekistan, with events focused on innovation.
The day marks the founding of the Food and Agriculture Organization in 1945.
items.exam: Static link: FAO was founded on 16 October 1945 (Quebec City); its headquarters is in Rome. SDG 2 is Zero Hunger.

items.en: AP SEC announces local body poll schedule: urban polls on 28 October
items.te: ఏపీ స్థానిక ఎన్నికల షెడ్యూల్ విడుదల: అక్టోబర్ 28న పట్టణ స్థానిక సంస్థల పోలింగ్
points: The State Election Commission announced the schedule on 14 October 2026; the model code of conduct is in force.
Urban local bodies: nominations 16–18 Oct, scrutiny 19 Oct, withdrawal till 21 Oct, polling 28 Oct, counting 30 Oct.
MPTC and ZPTC polls on 3 November, with results on 5 November.
Gram panchayat polls will be held in three phases between 26 November and 2 December.
items.exam: Static link: Articles 243K and 243ZA (State Election Commission conducts panchayat and municipal elections); 73rd and 74th Amendments, 1992.

items.en: President Murmu to inaugurate National SARAS Mela in Vijayawada
items.te: విజయవాడలో జాతీయ సరస్ మేళాను ప్రారంభించనున్న రాష్ట్రపతి ముర్ము
points: President Droupadi Murmu is on a two-day visit to Vijayawada on 14–15 October 2026.
She was scheduled to pray at the Kanaka Durga temple on Indrakeeladri on 14 October.
On 15 October she is to inaugurate the National SARAS Mela at Punnami Ghat and meet self-help group women and Lakhpati Didis.
The mela showcases products made by women's self-help groups from across the country.
items.exam: Static link: SARAS Aajeevika Melas are organised by the Ministry of Rural Development under DAY-NRLM (launched 2011 as Aajeevika) to market SHG products.

items.en: Wholesale inflation rises to 11.39% in September 2026
items.te: సెప్టెంబర్ 2026లో టోకు ద్రవ్యోల్బణం 11.39%కి పెరుగుదల
points: WPI inflation was 11.39% in September 2026 (provisional), up from 9.92% in August, per data released on 14 October.
Fuel and power inflation was the highest at 25.85% (22.93% in August).
Manufactured products inflation rose to 9.76% and primary articles to 8.67%.
The WPI series uses base year 2022-23.
items.exam: Static link: WPI is compiled by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT (Ministry of Commerce and Industry); RBI targets CPI, not WPI.

items.en: India hosts the first-ever BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting
items.te: తొలి బిమ్‌స్టెక్ హోం మంత్రుల సమావేశానికి భారత్ ఆతిథ్యం
points: The first BIMSTEC Home Ministers' Meeting was held in New Delhi on 13 October 2026, chaired by Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
Agenda: terrorism, transnational organised crime, narcotics, trafficking, illicit financial flows and cyber threats.
Senior home ministry officials of member states met a day earlier, on 12 October.
Bangladesh was represented by its Senior Home Secretary instead of its Home Minister.
items.exam: Static link: BIMSTEC was set up in 1997 (Bangkok Declaration); 7 members: Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Myanmar, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Thailand; secretariat in Dhaka.

items.en: AP SEC briefs parties; local body poll schedule to follow gazette notifications
items.te: రాజకీయ పార్టీలతో ఏపీ ఎస్ఈసీ భేటీ; గెజిట్ నోటిఫికేషన్ల తర్వాత స్థానిక ఎన్నికల షెడ్యూల్
points: On 13 October 2026 State Election Commissioner Anil Chandra Punetha briefed political parties on poll guidelines and procedures.
He said the schedule will be announced after the departments concerned issue gazette notifications.
On 12 October the government notified reservations for mayors of 17 corporations and chairpersons of 106 municipalities and nagar panchayats.
Reports said the elections are likely to be completed in November 2026.
items.exam: Static link: Article 243ZA vests superintendence of municipal elections in the State Election Commission (Article 243K for panchayats).

items.en: AP to add 22 dialysis centres under PM National Dialysis Programme
items.te: పీఎం నేషనల్ డయాలసిస్ ప్రోగ్రామ్ కింద ఏపీలో కొత్తగా 22 డయాలసిస్ కేంద్రాలు
points: Health Minister Satya Kumar Yadav said on 13 October 2026 that 22 new centres will be added, taking the State total to 83.
Each centre will have five dialysis machines and can run 15 sessions a day.
The estimated cost is about ₹85 lakh per centre.
items.exam: Static link: the Pradhan Mantri National Dialysis Programme was launched in 2016 under the National Health Mission to give free dialysis to the poor.

items.en: AP sanctions ₹59.73 crore for Godavari Pushkaram ghat works
items.te: గోదావరి పుష్కరాల ఘాట్ పనులకు ₹59.73 కోట్లు మంజూరు చేసిన ఏపీ
points: The State gave administrative approval of ₹59.73 crore for barricades and sheds at Godavari bathing ghats and temples.
The works are for the Godavari Pushkaralu due in 2027.
items.exam: Static link: a river's Pushkaralu come once in 12 years; the Godavari Pushkaram is held when Jupiter enters Simha (Leo).

items.en: President appoints new Governors for six States
items.te: ఆరు రాష్ట్రాలకు కొత్త గవర్నర్లను నియమించిన రాష్ట్రపతి
points: On 12 October 2026 President Droupadi Murmu named Governors for Tamil Nadu, Kerala, Karnataka, Odisha, Uttarakhand and Sikkim.
Rajendra Arlekar moves from Kerala to Tamil Nadu; Om Prakash Mathur moves from Sikkim to Kerala.
New Governors: Sudha Yadav (Karnataka), Braj Mohan Ram (Odisha), Dhal Singh Bisen (Uttarakhand), Dushyant Gautam (Sikkim).
The appointments take effect from the dates they assume charge.
items.exam: Static link: Article 155 (Governor appointed by the President by warrant), Article 156 (holds office during the President's pleasure; 5-year term), 7th Amendment, 1956 (one Governor for two or more States).

items.en: INS Mangrol, third anti-submarine shallow water craft, set to join the Navy
items.te: మూడో యాంటీ-సబ్‌మెరైన్ షాలో వాటర్ క్రాఫ్ట్ ఐఎన్ఎస్ మంగ్రోల్ నౌకాదళంలో చేరిక
points: INS Mangrol was scheduled to be commissioned on 12 October 2026 at the Naval Dockyard, Mumbai.
It is the third Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW SWC) built by Cochin Shipyard Ltd, with over 80% indigenous content.
It carries the Abhay hull-mounted sonar, lightweight torpedoes, an indigenous anti-submarine rocket launcher and the Mareech decoy system.
It is named after the earlier minesweeper INS Mangrol, which served until 2004.
items.exam: Static link: 16 ASW SWCs are being built for the Navy, 8 each by GRSE (Kolkata) and Cochin Shipyard; they hunt submarines in coastal waters.

items.en: AP notifies mayor reservations for all 17 municipal corporations
items.te: 17 మున్సిపల్ కార్పొరేషన్ల మేయర్ పదవులకు రిజర్వేషన్లు ఖరారు చేసిన ఏపీ
points: G.O. No. 252 of the MA&UD Department fixed mayor reservations; it was to appear in the AP Gazette on 12 October 2026.
Split: 5 BC, 2 SC (Rajahmundry, Kurnool), 1 ST (Mangalagiri-Tadepalli), 5 general women and 4 unreserved.
Visakhapatnam and Guntur are reserved for women (general); Vijayawada, Tirupati, Ongole and Nellore are unreserved.
The reservations come ahead of the urban local body elections.
items.exam: Static link: Article 243T(4) lets the State legislature reserve chairperson (mayor) posts in municipalities for SCs, STs and women; 74th Amendment, 1992.

items.en: AP Cabinet approves gratuity for ASHA workers and a foreign universities policy
items.te: ఆశా వర్కర్లకు గ్రాట్యుటీ, విదేశీ విశ్వవిద్యాలయాల విధానానికి ఏపీ మంత్రివర్గం ఆమోదం
points: At its 7 October 2026 meeting the AP Cabinet approved 12 agenda items.
Eligible ASHA workers get gratuity of ₹5,000 per completed year of service, up to ₹1.5 lakh.
It approved the AP Policy for Promotion of Foreign Higher Educational Institutions and Private Universities, 2026.
The policy aims to attract foreign and reputed private universities to set up campuses in AP.
items.exam: Static link: ASHA (Accredited Social Health Activist) was introduced under the National Rural Health Mission, 2005; ASHAs are honorary volunteers, not regular employees.

items.en: Retail inflation rises to 5.54% in September 2026; food inflation at 7.74%
items.te: సెప్టెంబర్ 2026లో రిటైల్ ద్రవ్యోల్బణం 5.54%కి పెరుగుదల; ఆహార ద్రవ్యోల్బణం 7.74%
points: MoSPI data released on 12 October 2026 put CPI inflation at 5.54% (provisional), up from 4.83% in August.
Rural inflation was 6.08% and urban inflation 4.88%.
Food inflation (CFPI) rose to 7.74% from 5.97% in August; onion prices led the rise.
The CPI series now uses base year 2024=100.
items.exam: Static link: RBI's inflation target is 4% CPI with a ±2% band (flexible inflation targeting, RBI Act amended 2016); CPI is compiled by NSO, MoSPI.

items.en: Robert E. Hall and Michael Woodford win the 2026 Nobel Prize in Economics
items.te: 2026 ఆర్థిక శాస్త్ర నోబెల్ బహుమతి రాబర్ట్ ఇ. హాల్, మైకేల్ వుడ్‌ఫోర్డ్‌లకు
points: Announced on 12 October 2026; Hall is at Stanford University and Woodford at Columbia University.
Their work shows how household and firm decisions shape the economy and how policy can smooth boom-bust cycles.
Their models underpin the "New Keynesian" approach used by central banks; Woodford's work shaped forward guidance.
The winners share 12 million Swedish kronor; it was the last Nobel announcement of 2026.
items.exam: Static link: the economics prize (Sveriges Riksbank Prize in memory of Alfred Nobel) was set up in 1968 and first awarded in 1969.

items.en: India's first indigenous Fleet Support Ship "Surya" launched at HSL Visakhapatnam
items.te: విశాఖపట్నం హెచ్‌ఎస్‌ఎల్‌లో దేశీయ తొలి ఫ్లీట్ సపోర్ట్ షిప్ "సూర్య" జలప్రవేశం
points: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh launched FSS-1 "Surya" at Hindustan Shipyard Ltd (HSL), Visakhapatnam, on 6 October 2026.
It is the first of five Fleet Support Ships HSL is building for the Indian Navy.
About 43,500 tonnes displacement and 223.6 m long; it carries fuel, water, ammunition and stores to ships at sea.
At the same event the keel of FSS-5 was laid, and an upgraded Slipway-4 and a 300-tonne Goliath crane were opened.
The ship is expected to join the Navy around mid-2027 after trials.
items.exam: AP angle: HSL, Visakhapatnam (under the Ministry of Defence). Know the difference: keel laying → launch (enters water) → delivery → commissioning.

items.en: IAF multinational air exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 concludes at Jodhpur
items.te: జోధ్‌పూర్‌లో భారత వైమానిక దళ బహుళ దేశాల విన్యాసం తరంగ్ శక్తి 2026 ముగింపు
points: The second edition of the IAF's multinational exercise Tarang Shakti ran from 26 September to 12 October 2026.
It was held at Air Force Station Jodhpur, Rajasthan, and adjoining air bases.
Participating air forces include Australia, France, Germany, the USA, the UAE, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh.
All India Radio reported that 32 countries attended as observers.
The first edition of Tarang Shakti was held in 2024.
items.exam: Defence exercises list: Tarang Shakti is the IAF's own multinational air exercise hosted in India; note the host base (Jodhpur) and edition (2nd).

items.en: 11 October: birth anniversaries of Jayaprakash Narayan and Nanaji Deshmukh
items.te: అక్టోబర్ 11: జయప్రకాశ్ నారాయణ్, నానాజీ దేశ్‌ముఖ్ జయంతి
points: The Prime Minister paid tributes to both leaders on 11 October 2026.
Jayaprakash Narayan (born 11 Oct 1902) gave the call for "Sampoorna Kranti" (Total Revolution) in 1974.
JP co-founded the Congress Socialist Party (1934), won the Ramon Magsaysay Award (1965) and the Bharat Ratna (1999, posthumous).
Nanaji Deshmukh (born 11 Oct 1916) led rural self-reliance work at Chitrakoot through the Deendayal Research Institute.
Nanaji was awarded the Bharat Ratna posthumously in 2019.
items.exam: Modern India / personalities: JP Movement (Bihar, 1974) and the Emergency (1975–77); Bharat Ratna 2019 went to Nanaji Deshmukh, Pranab Mukherjee and Bhupen Hazarika.

items.en: AP Cabinet finalises BC reservation for local bodies after Supreme Court verdict
items.te: సుప్రీంకోర్టు తీర్పు తర్వాత స్థానిక సంస్థల్లో బీసీ రిజర్వేషన్లను ఖరారు చేసిన ఏపీ మంత్రివర్గం
points: On 10 October 2026 the AP Cabinet fixed BC quotas for local bodies based on the Rajiv Ranjan Mishra commission report.
The commission estimated the BC share of the population at 50.42%.
Reported quotas: gram panchayat ward members 26.73%, sarpanches 27.95%, MPTCs 25.55%, ZPTCs 24.60%, ZP chairpersons 23.08%, urban wards 32.78%.
The decision came a day after the Supreme Court left the High Court order quashing the 34% BC quota in force.
items.exam: Static link: Article 243D(6) and 243T(6) allow BC reservation in panchayats and municipalities; the 50% ceiling (Indra Sawhney, 1992) and the triple test (Vikas Kishanrao Gawali, 2021).

items.en: AP appoints CEOs to Zilla Praja Parishads reconstituted for 28 districts
items.te: 28 జిల్లాలకు పునర్వ్యవస్థీకరించిన జిల్లా ప్రజా పరిషత్‌లకు సీఈఓల నియామకం
points: The AP government appointed CEOs and deputy CEOs to Zilla Praja Parishads reconstituted after the State was reorganised into 28 districts.
The two new districts are Polavaram (headquarters Rampachodavaram, carved from Alluri Sitharama Raju district) and Markapuram (carved from Prakasam).
The reorganisation raised the number of districts from 26 to 28.
items.exam: Remember AP now has 28 districts. Static link: Article 243B provides three tiers of panchayats; the Zilla Parishad is the district tier (ZPTC members elected under the AP Panchayat Raj Act, 1994).

items.en: AP plans to develop Polavaram project as a tourist destination before 2027 Pushkaralu
items.te: 2027 గోదావరి పుష్కరాల లోపు పోలవరం ప్రాజెక్టును పర్యాటక కేంద్రంగా తీర్చిదిద్దేందుకు ఏపీ ప్రణాళిక
points: A 10 October 2026 report says the State aims to dedicate Polavaram to the nation before the Godavari Pushkaralu at the end of June 2027.
The plan includes road links to national highways and tourism facilities around the reservoir.
In July 2026 the CM reviewed a riverfront master plan by Nippon Koei, including a 500-acre island downstream of the spillway.
items.exam: Static link: Polavaram (Indira Sagar) on the Godavari is a national project under Section 90 of the AP Reorganisation Act, 2014; Godavari Pushkaralu are held once in 12 years.

items.en: RBI opens special dollar window for oil companies to ease pressure on rupee
items.te: రూపాయిపై ఒత్తిడి తగ్గించేందుకు చమురు సంస్థలకు ఆర్‌బీఐ ప్రత్యేక డాలర్ విండో
points: On 10 October 2026 the RBI said it will meet the full daily dollar needs of IOC, HPCL and BPCL through designated banks from 12 October.
The rupee closed at ₹96.73 per dollar on 9 October, near its all-time low of ₹96.96 touched in May 2026.
The RBI also barred rebooking of cancelled INR forex derivative contracts; it has not disclosed the volume of dollars to be supplied.
The RBI opened a similar window for the same three companies in August 2013.
items.exam: Static link: RBI manages forex reserves and the exchange rate under the RBI Act, 1934 and FEMA, 1999; a weaker rupee makes crude imports costlier and widens the current account deficit.

items.en: Supreme Court sets up Standing Committee on Judicial Well-being
items.te: న్యాయ వ్యవస్థ శ్రేయస్సుపై సుప్రీంకోర్టు స్టాండింగ్ కమిటీ ఏర్పాటు
points: CJI Surya Kant constituted the committee on 10 October 2026, World Mental Health Day; Justice K.V. Viswanathan chairs it.
It will examine occupational stress, workload and mental health of judicial officers across the country.
It followed a Centre for Research and Planning study on the district judiciary that flagged stress, heavy workloads and staff shortages.
Members include psychiatrist Dr Savita Malhotra and psychologist Rajat Mitra.
items.exam: Static link: the Supreme Court is established under Article 124; the CJI is the master of the roster; control over subordinate courts lies with High Courts under Article 235.

items.en: World Mental Health Day: Tele-MANAS helpline crosses 47 lakh calls
items.te: ప్రపంచ మానసిక ఆరోగ్య దినోత్సవం: 47 లక్షలు దాటిన టెలీ-మానస్ కాల్స్
points: The Health Ministry observed World Mental Health Day on 10 October 2026.
The Tele-MANAS helpline has received about 47.75 lakh calls since its launch, according to the ministry.
Tele-MANAS was launched on 10 October 2022; its toll-free number is 14416.
As of March 2026, 36 States/UTs had set up 53 Tele-MANAS cells.
items.exam: Static link: Mental Healthcare Act, 2017 (decriminalised attempted suicide under Section 115); National Mental Health Programme (1982) and District Mental Health Programme; health is a State List subject.

items.en: Supreme Court dismisses AP plea on 34% BC quota in local body elections
items.te: స్థానిక సంస్థల ఎన్నికల్లో 34% బీసీ రిజర్వేషన్లపై ఏపీ పిటిషన్‌ను కొట్టివేసిన సుప్రీంకోర్టు
points: On 9 October 2026 the Supreme Court dismissed the AP government's plea against the High Court order quashing 34% BC reservation in local bodies.
The AP High Court had struck down the two government orders on 1 October 2026, holding that the quota breached the 50% ceiling on total reservations.
A bench of Justices Dipankar Datta and Sheel Nagu called the High Court order reasonable; the HC had questioned the State's data behind the 34% figure.
The State had relied on data from a Unified Family Survey to fix the quota.
items.exam: Static link: Article 243D(6) lets States reserve seats for backward classes in panchayats; Indra Sawhney (1992) 50% ceiling; K. Krishnamurthy (2010) on local-body BC quota; "triple test" from Vikas Kishanrao Gawali (2021).

items.en: Supreme Court clears the way for Andhra Pradesh local body elections
items.te: ఏపీ స్థానిక సంస్థల ఎన్నికలకు సుప్రీంకోర్టు మార్గం సుగమం
points: On 9 October 2026 a bench led by CJI Surya Kant said the ongoing SIR of electoral rolls cannot be used to delay AP local body polls.
If revised SIR rolls are not published before the election notification, polls must be held on the existing electoral rolls.
The terms of AP urban local bodies expired on 17 March 2026 and those of Gram Panchayats on 2 April 2026.
The State Election Commission had said it was awaiting the verdict before announcing the schedule.
items.exam: Static link: State Election Commission under Article 243K (panchayats) and 243ZA (municipalities); five-year term under Articles 243E and 243U; elections must be completed before the term expires.

items.en: CM Naidu says Andhra Pradesh secured ₹22 lakh crore investment in 28 months
items.te: 28 నెలల్లో ఏపీకి ₹22 లక్షల కోట్ల పెట్టుబడులు: సీఎం చంద్రబాబు నాయుడు
points: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu made the claim at the CII Partnership Summit 2026 curtain-raiser in New Delhi on 8 October 2026.
Union Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal attended the event.
Naidu said companies such as ArcelorMittal and Google are setting up operations in the State.
He also said the NALA Act, which he called a hurdle to investment, has been repealed.
items.exam: Remember this as the CM's stated figure, not an audited total. Link to AP's investment promotion (SIPB), ease of doing business and the Swarna Andhra @2047 vision.

items.en: CAPF (General Administration) Act, 2026 comes into force
items.te: కేంద్ర సాయుధ పోలీసు బలగాల (సాధారణ పరిపాలన) చట్టం, 2026 అమల్లోకి
points: The Ministry of Home Affairs notified 8 October 2026 as the date the Act comes into force.
It sets a common framework for recruitment and service conditions of Group A general duty officers of CRPF, BSF, CISF, ITBP and SSB.
It reserves 50% of Inspector General posts, at least 67% of ADG posts and all Special DG and DG posts for IPS officers on deputation.
The President gave assent on 9 April 2026; its constitutional validity is being challenged in the Supreme Court.
items.exam: Remember the five forces covered (CRPF, BSF, CISF, ITBP, SSB) and that they function under the MHA. Police is a State List subject (Entry 2, List II).

items.en: Nobel Peace Prize 2026 awarded to Navi Pillay
items.te: నవీ పిళ్లైకి 2026 నోబెల్ శాంతి బహుమతి
points: The Norwegian Nobel Committee announced the prize in Oslo on 9 October 2026.
South African jurist Navanethem "Navi" Pillay, former UN human rights chief, was honoured "for her efforts to promote peace and international law".
She served as a judge of the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda and was part of the anti-apartheid movement.
The prize will be presented in Oslo on 10 December 2026.
items.exam: Static link: Peace Prize is awarded in Oslo by the Norwegian Nobel Committee; all other Nobel Prizes are presented in Stockholm on 10 December (Alfred Nobel's death anniversary).

items.en: Canadian poet Anne Carson wins the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature
items.te: కెనడా కవయిత్రి ఆన్ కార్సన్‌కు 2026 సాహిత్య నోబెల్ బహుమతి
points: The Swedish Academy announced the award on 8 October 2026.
Carson, 76, is a poet, essayist and professor of classics.
Her known works include "Autobiography of Red", a novel in verse, and "The Beauty of the Husband".
The prize will be formally presented in Stockholm on 10 December 2026.
items.exam: Static link: the Swedish Academy chooses the Literature laureate; Rabindranath Tagore (1913, Gitanjali) is the only Indian Literature laureate.

items.en: Ladakh launches India's first high-altitude snow leopard safari
items.te: లద్దాఖ్‌లో దేశంలోనే తొలి హై-ఆల్టిట్యూడ్ స్నో లెపర్డ్ సఫారీ ప్రారంభం
points: Lt Governor Vinai Kumar Saxena flagged off six safari vehicles on 8 October 2026 during Wildlife Week at Choglamsar Protected Forest, Leh.
It is run by the SHAN Society with the UT Ladakh Department of Forest, Ecology and Environment.
Vehicles will first operate in Rumbak, Shang and Uley; more routes are being identified, including Hemis National Park.
Ladakh is reported to have 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards.
items.exam: Static link: snow leopard is "Vulnerable" on the IUCN Red List and in Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972; Hemis is India's largest national park; Wildlife Week is 2–8 October.

items.en: Windergy India 2026 opens in Chennai with a 100 GW wind target for 2030
items.te: చెన్నైలో విండర్జీ ఇండియా 2026 ప్రారంభం; 2030 నాటికి 100 GW పవన విద్యుత్ లక్ష్యం
points: Union New and Renewable Energy Minister Pralhad Joshi inaugurated the 8th edition at the Chennai Trade Centre on 8 October 2026.
The theme was "Wind – Powering India's Energy Resilience"; it is organised by IWTMA and PDA Ventures.
The wind industry is targeting 100 GW of installed capacity by 2030, needing about 10 GW of additions a year.
items.exam: Static link: MNRE; National Institute of Wind Energy (NIWE) is in Chennai; Tamil Nadu and Gujarat lead in wind capacity; India's 500 GW non-fossil capacity target for 2030.

items.en: APPSC Publishes Three Major Recruitment Notifications
items.te: ఏపీపీఎస్సీ మూడు కీలక నియామక నోటిఫికేషన్లను విడుదల చేసింది
points: On 6 October 2026, Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission (APPSC) published three major recruitment notifications.
Notification No. 07/2026 covers Group-I Services (General Recruitment).
Notification No. 08/2026 is for Assistant Environmental Engineer in the A.P. Pollution Control Board.
Notification No. 19/2026 is for Horticulture Officer in the A.P. Horticulture Service.
APPSC listed detailed notifications and online application submission links for these recruitments on its official website.
items.exam: Prelims—memorise notification numbers and the corresponding services. Mains—relate transparent recruitment to administrative efficiency and public service delivery. Verify eligibility and application deadlines in the detailed notifications.

items.en: 57th GST Council Recommends Major Compliance Reforms
items.te: 57వ జీఎస్టీ మండలి పన్ను అనుసరణను సులభతరం చేసే కీలక సంస్కరణలకు సిఫారసు చేసింది
points: The 57th GST Council meeting was held in New Delhi on 8 October 2026 under Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman.
The Council recommended raising the monetary threshold for GST prosecution from ₹1 crore to ₹5 crore.
It recommended reducing the general penalty from ₹25,000 to ₹10,000.
Recommendations include simpler GST registration, faster automated refunds, improved input tax credit procedures and common standards for notices.
An optional scheme was approved in principle for small consumer-facing businesses with turnover up to ₹5 crore.
items.exam: Prelims—Article 279A, GST Council composition and chairperson. Mains—cooperative federalism, ease of doing business and tax compliance. Remember that Council recommendations may require legislative or rule changes before implementation.

items.en: World Development Report 2026 Highlights AI for Development
items.te: ప్రపంచ అభివృద్ధి నివేదిక 2026లో అభివృద్ధి కోసం కృత్రిమ మేధస్సు వినియోగంపై దృష్టి
points: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the World Bank Group’s World Development Report 2026: The Promise of Artificial Intelligence in New Delhi on 8 October 2026.
The India launch was organised jointly by the IndiaAI Mission, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), and the World Bank Group.
The report proposes three broad approaches for developing economies: AI adoption, adaptation and advancement.

AI can improve productivity and public services in healthcare, agriculture, education and governance, but requires reliable electricity, connectivity, computing infrastructure, quality data and skilled people.
Andhra Pradesh’s Navachetana initiative, which uses AI-enabled early screening to identify developmental delays in children aged 0–6 years, featured in the State AI Showcase.
items.exam: Prelims—report title, publishing institution and the three-part AI framework. Mains—responsible AI, digital inclusion, public-service delivery and Andhra Pradesh’s application of AI in child development.

items.en: India Mobile Congress 2026 Advances India’s 6G Ambitions
items.te: ఇండియా మొబైల్ కాంగ్రెస్ 2026 ద్వారా 6G సాంకేతికతలో భారత్ నాయకత్వ లక్ష్యాలు
points: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 10th India Mobile Congress (IMC) at Yashobhoomi, New Delhi, on 8 October 2026.
The event was organised jointly by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT) and the Cellular Operators Association of India (COAI) under the theme “Scale Without Boundaries”.
India has approximately 5.5 lakh 5G base stations, with 5G connectivity reaching 99.9% of districts, according to the government’s IMC address.
India aims to connect 1 billion 5G users by 2030 and secure at least 10% of global 6G patents and standards.
The government has called for Indian alternatives to 10–20 critical imported network technologies, alongside advances in quantum communications and AI-native networks.
items.exam: Prelims—IMC, DoT, COAI, 5G infrastructure and the 6G patent target. Mains—digital infrastructure, indigenous technology, telecom security and technological self-reliance.

items.en: National Biodiversity Authority Receives ₹9.68 Crore Under Benefit-Sharing Framework
items.te: జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రయోజనాల భాగస్వామ్య విధానం కింద జాతీయ జీవ వైవిధ్య ప్రాధికార సంస్థకు రూ.9.68 కోట్లు
points: The National Biodiversity Authority (NBA) received ₹9.68 crore during April–September 2026 from users of India’s biological resources.
The receipts included ₹7.16 crore from the agriculture/agri-seed sector, ₹1.59 crore from food and beverages, and ₹62.01 lakh from animal husbandry.
The Access and Benefit Sharing (ABS) framework operates under the Biological Diversity Act, 2002, as amended in 2023, and the applicable ABS Regulations.
Since 2008, the NBA has realised approximately ₹278 crore through ABS and disbursed more than ₹200 crore towards biodiversity conservation and benefits for communities, farmers and institutions.
items.exam: Prelims—NBA, Biological Diversity Act, 2002, the 2023 amendment and Access and Benefit Sharing. Mains—biodiversity conservation, sustainable use of biological resources and equitable sharing of benefits with local communities.

items.en: India Calls for Climate Finance and Technology Transfer Ahead of COP31
items.te: COP31కు ముందు వాతావరణ ఆర్థిక సహాయం, సాంకేతిక బదిలీకి భారత్ పిలుపు
points: At the Pre-COP31 meeting in Fiji on 8 October 2026, Union Environment Minister Bhupender Yadav called for flexibility, pragmatism and mutual respect among countries.
India emphasised that higher climate ambition must be matched by scaled-up climate finance, technology transfer and capacity-building.
India reiterated that climate action must respect nationally determined pathways and the development priorities of individual countries.
The discussions stressed the importance of the 1.5°C global warming goal and implementation of commitments under the UN climate framework.
COP31 is scheduled to take place in Antalya, Türkiye, in November 2026.
items.exam: Prelims—UNFCCC, COP31, the Paris Agreement and Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs). Mains—climate justice, finance for developing countries, technology transfer and balancing mitigation with adaptation.

items.en: PRASHAST Promotes Inclusive Education Across Indian Schools
items.te: ప్రశస్త్ ద్వారా ప్రత్యేక అవసరాలు గల పిల్లల సమ్మిళిత విద్యపై దేశవ్యాప్త అవగాహన
points: The Department of School Education and Literacy conducted nationwide screening of a 30-minute inclusive-education sensitisation module through the PRASHAST Portal on 8 October 2026.
More than 60,000 schools participated, and over 72 lakh teachers had already been sensitised through the initiative.
The module is available in 12 Indian languages and targets school heads, teachers, special educators and non-teaching staff.
PRASHAST is a school-based digital tool that helps identify children with probable disability conditions covered by the Rights of Persons with Disabilities (RPwD) Act, 2016.
Teachers use a two-part checklist for initial screening; special educators validate cases and facilitate referrals for medical assessment when required.
items.exam: Prelims—PRASHAST, RPwD Act, 2016, and National Education Policy (NEP) 2020. Mains—inclusive education, accessibility, early identification of disabilities and equitable educational opportunities for Children with Special Needs (CwSN).

items.en: JOSH Teams Launched to Strengthen India’s TB Elimination Drive
items.te: క్షయవ్యాధి నిర్మూలనకు యువత భాగస్వామ్యాన్ని పెంచేందుకు జోష్ బృందాల ప్రారంభం
points: Union Health Minister J.P. Nadda launched JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams on 8 October 2026 under the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.
The first phase covers 55 districts across 11 States and Union Territories, with plans for nationwide expansion.
A total of 67,933 Panchayats across 697 districts were recognised as TB Mukt in 2026.
The government reported a 21% decline in India’s TB incidence, compared with a 12% global decline, and treatment coverage of 92%, compared with the global figure of 78%.
JOSH Teams aim to mobilise young people for awareness, early diagnosis, timely treatment, treatment adherence and reduction of TB-related stigma.
items.exam: Prelims—expand JOSH, identify the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan and remember the reported indicators. Mains—public health, community participation, early diagnosis, treatment continuity and youth-led health interventions.

items.en: Indian Women’s Hockey Team Wins Asian Games Gold After Four Decades
items.te: నాలుగు దశాబ్దాలకు పైగా విరామం తర్వాత ఆసియా క్రీడల్లో భారత మహిళల హాకీ జట్టుకు స్వర్ణం
points: India’s women’s hockey team won Asian Games gold, ending a wait of more than four decades; Prime Minister Narendra Modi congratulated the team on 2 October 2026.
The Indian men’s hockey team retained its Asian Games gold medal.
The Indian men’s cricket team also retained its gold medal at the Games.
Other notable achievements included Aman Sehrawat’s gold in men’s 57 kg freestyle wrestling and Pranavi Sharath Urs’s gold in women’s individual golf.
items.exam: Prelims—match athletes with their sports and events; distinguish team and individual competitions. Mains—sports development, athlete support systems, gender representation and India’s international sporting performance.

items.en: World Post Day 2026 Begins National Postal Week
items.te: ప్రపంచ తపాలా దినోత్సవం 2026తో జాతీయ తపాలా వారోత్సవాల ప్రారంభం
points: World Post Day is observed on 9 October; India’s National Postal Week runs from 9 to 15 October 2026.
This year’s Indian observance uses the theme “One Postal Network, Infinite Possibilities”.
The Department of Posts is highlighting modern service initiatives such as N-Gen Post Offices, Jan Sewa Connect Post Offices, the Dak Sewa App and the Dak Mitra App.
National Postal Week focuses on financial inclusion, digital empowerment, mail and parcel services, philately, and technology-driven postal modernisation.

World Post Day marks the establishment of the Universal Postal Union (UPU) on 9 October 1874, following the signing of the Treaty of Bern by 22 countries; the UPU is headquartered in Bern, Switzerland.
items.exam: Prelims—World Post Day date and theme, National Postal Week dates, UPU establishment in 1874 and headquarters at Bern. Mains—financial inclusion, last-mile public services and digital transformation of India Post.

items.en: AP drought declaration highlights severe rainfall stress in Rayalaseema
items.te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో కరువు ప్రకటనతో రాయలసీమలో వర్షాభావ పరిస్థితులు వెలుగులోకి
points: Andhra Pradesh has declared drought in 388 of 688 mandals across 21 districts.
186 of the drought-declared mandals are located in Rayalaseema.
The declaration is linked to significant southwest monsoon rainfall deficiency.
The development has implications for crop-loss assessment, drinking water, irrigation and relief measures.
items.exam: Drought declaration; Disaster Management Act, 2005; Rayalaseema; monsoon variability; agricultural distress; State disaster management.

items.en: Andhra Pradesh expands real-time water-resource monitoring through National Water Data Portal
items.te: నేషనల్ వాటర్ డేటా పోర్టల్ ద్వారా ఏపీలో నీటి వనరుల రియల్-టైమ్ పర్యవేక్షణ విస్తరణ
points: Andhra Pradesh Surface Water Department is providing river-discharge, river-level and meteorological datasets through the National Water Data Portal.
The portal includes daily river-discharge and velocity datasets covering Andhra Pradesh.
Updated datasets for the 2026–2030 period are available for hydrological monitoring.
Such data supports flood forecasting, irrigation planning, water-resource management and environmental assessment.
items.exam: National Water Informatics Centre (NWIC); Ministry of Jal Shakti; hydrological data; river discharge; flood management; water governance.

items.en: ఆసియా క్రీడల్లో భారత్
items.te: 2026 ఆసియా క్రీడల్లో భారత్ 85 పతకాలతో నాలుగో స్థానంలో
points: Aichi–Nagoya 2026 Asian Games జపాన్‌లో నిర్వహించబడ్డాయి.
భారత్ మొత్తం 85 పతకాలు సాధించింది.
ఇందులో 21 స్వర్ణాలు, 27 రజతాలు, 37 కాంస్య పతకాలు ఉన్నాయి.
అథ్లెటిక్స్, ఆర్చరీ, షూటింగ్, హాకీ, క్రికెట్ తదితర క్రీడల్లో భారత్ మంచి ప్రదర్శన చేసింది.
items.exam: Asian Games 2026; Aichi–Nagoya; India Medal Tally; Olympic qualification; భారత క్రీడలు.

items.en: 2026 భౌతిక శాస్త్ర నోబెల్ బహుమతి
items.te: 2026 భౌతిక శాస్త్ర నోబెల్ బహుమతి ఫ్రాన్సిస్ హాల్జెన్‌కు
points: Francis Halzenకు 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics లభించింది.
ఆయన IceCube Neutrino Observatoryకి సంబంధించిన పరిశోధనలకు గుర్తింపు పొందారు.
IceCube పరిశీలన కేంద్రం దక్షిణ ధ్రువం (South Pole) వద్ద ఉంది.
అధిక శక్తి గల ఖగోళ న్యూట్రినోల (Astrophysical Neutrinos) అధ్యయనంలో ఈ పరిశోధన కీలకం.
items.exam: న్యూట్రినోలు; IceCube; ఖగోళ భౌతిక శాస్త్రం; Nobel Prize; South Pole.

items.en: భారత వైమానిక దళానికి కొత్త చీఫ్ నియామకం
items.te: భారత వైమానిక దళ తదుపరి చీఫ్‌గా ఎయిర్ మార్షల్ అశుతోష్ దీక్షిత్
points: Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixitను తదుపరి Chief of the Air Staffగా నియమించారు.
ఆయన భారత వైమానిక దళంలో 29వ Chief of the Air Staffగా బాధ్యతలు చేపట్టనున్నారు.
ఆయన 31 అక్టోబర్ 2026 నుంచి బాధ్యతలు స్వీకరించనున్నారు.
ఆయన ప్రస్తుతం Vice Chief of the Air Staffగా పనిచేస్తున్నారు.
items.exam: భారత సాయుధ దళాలు; Chief of Air Staff; Indian Air Force; రక్షణ వ్యవస్థలో నియామకాలు.

items.en: SAREX-2026 నిర్వహణ
items.te: భారత కోస్ట్ గార్డ్ ఆధ్వర్యంలో SAREX-2026
points: SAREX అంటే National Maritime Search and Rescue Exercise.
2026లో 12వ జాతీయ సముద్ర శోధన మరియు రక్షణ విన్యాసం నిర్వహిస్తున్నారు.
Indian Coast Guard ఈ విన్యాసానికి ప్రధాన సంస్థ.
సముద్ర ప్రమాదాల్లో శోధన, రక్షణ మరియు వివిధ సంస్థల సమన్వయాన్ని పరీక్షించడం దీని లక్ష్యం.
items.exam: Indian Coast Guard; Maritime Search and Rescue; సముద్ర భద్రత; విపత్తు నిర్వహణ.

items.en: APPSC GROUP-I 2026 — Detailed Notification విడుదల
points: APPSC Notification No.07/2026 ను 6 అక్టోబర్ 2026న విడుదల చేసింది. Group-I Servicesకి సంబంధించిన detailed notification ఇప్పుడు APPSC అధికారిక వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో అందుబాటులో ఉంది.
items.exam: Notification No.07/2026 | Group-I Services | Screening Test → Mains → Interview

items.en: SME Growth Fund — ₹10,000 కోట్లు
points: కేంద్ర కేబినెట్ Small & Medium Enterprises Growth Fund కోసం ₹10,000 కోట్లు కేటాయించడానికి ఆమోదం తెలిపింది. High-potential SMEsకి equity capital అందించడం దీని ప్రధాన లక్ష్యం.

items.en: Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority
points: కేంద్ర ప్రభుత్వం ITLA (Integrated Transport & Logistics Authority) ఏర్పాటు చేయడానికి ఆమోదం తెలిపింది. ఇది transport & logistics రంగంలో research, planning, project appraisal, monitoring మరియు impact assessmentకు ప్రత్యేక institutional mechanismగా పనిచేస్తుంది.

items.en: eSanjeevani — 50 కోట్లు Teleconsultations
points: భారతదేశ National Telemedicine Service eSanjeevani 50 కోట్లు (500 million) teleconsultations milestoneను దాటింది. ఇది C-DAC అభివృద్ధి చేసిన Made-in-India digital health platform.

items.en: AIIMS Bilaspur — First Convocation
points: AIIMS Bilaspurలో మొదటి Convocation జరిగింది. Instituteలో మొదటి MBBS batch January 2021లో ప్రారంభమైంది; 2022లో formally inaugurated అయింది.

items.en: Chintan Shivir 2026 — ముగింపు
points: MoRTH నిర్వహించిన Chintan Shivir 2026 5–6 Octoberలో Gujaratలోని Ekta Nagar, Statue of Unity వద్ద జరిగింది. Highway infrastructureలో Centre–State coordination, best practices మరియు institutional capacityపై దృష్టి పెట్టింది.

items.en: Goa Legislative Assembly — 25 Years
points: Goa Legislative Assembly Building 25 సంవత్సరాలు పూర్తి చేసుకున్న సందర్భంగా Silver Jubilee celebrations ప్రారంభమయ్యాయి. Democracyలో dialogue, diverse views మరియు public participation ప్రాముఖ్యతపై దృష్టి పెట్టారు.

items.en: AP Rainfall — ముఖ్యమైన Environment Update
points: AP Government DES ప్రకారం 1 June–6 October 2026 మధ్య రాష్ట్ర cumulative rainfall normal కంటే 37.8% తక్కువగా ఉంది. Tirupatiలో −39.3%, Annamayyaలో −55.8%, Chittoorలో −46.2% deviation నమోదైంది.

items.en: APలో 6 October Rainfall — Annamayya Highlight
points: 5–6 October 2026 మధ్య 24 గంటల్లో Annamayya జిల్లాలోని కొన్ని ప్రాంతాల్లో భారీ వర్షపాతం నమోదైంది; Madanapalle – 90.1 mm, Valmikipuram – 86.25 mm నమోదయ్యాయి.

items.en: MSME Ecosystem — Important Facts
points: 6 October నాటికి Udyam + Udyam Assist Platformలో MSME registrations సుమారు 9.78 కోట్లు, reported employment opportunities సుమారు 43.28 కోట్లుగా PIB పేర్కొంది. Female-owned enterprises మొత్తం registrationsలో 37.6% ఉన్నాయి.

items.en: Andhra Pradesh launches ₹30,156 crore Amarajeevi Jaladhara programme
items.te: ఆంధ్రప్రదేశ్‌లో ₹30,156 కోట్ల అమరజీవి జలధార కార్యక్రమం ప్రారంభం
points: The Andhra Pradesh Government launched the Amarajeevi Jaladhara programme under Jal Jeevan Mission 2.0 on 5 October 2026
The programme has an estimated outlay of ₹30,156.12 crore
It aims to provide new tap-water connections to 27.36 lakh rural households across 24,601 habitations
The programme targets safe drinking water supply at 55 litres per person per day
items.exam: Jal Jeevan Mission; Ministry of Jal Shakti; rural drinking-water governance; Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC); Centre–State cooperation.

items.en: APPSC Phase-2 recruitment applications begin from 6 October
items.te: ఏపీపీఎస్సీ ఫేజ్-2 నియామకాలకు అక్టోబర్ 6 నుంచి దరఖాస్తులు ప్రారంభం
points: APPSC Phase-2 recruitment notifications begin accepting applications from 6 October 2026
Group-I Services notification carries 163 provisional vacancies
Assistant Environmental Engineer posts have 40 vacancies and Horticulture Officer posts have 37 vacancies
The Group-I application window is scheduled from 6 October to 27 October 2026
items.exam: APPSC Group-I recruitment; APPSC 2026 Job Calendar; constitutional role of State Public Service Commissions; Articles 315–323.

items.en: RoDTEP scheme extended until 31 December 2026
items.te: ఎగుమతిదారులకు RoDTEP పథకం గడువు డిసెంబర్ 31, 2026 వరకు పొడిగింపు
points: The Government extended the Remission of Duties and Taxes on Exported Products (RoDTEP) scheme until 31 December 2026
RoDTEP aims to refund embedded central, state and local duties and taxes that are not otherwise refunded
The scheme is designed to improve the international competitiveness of Indian exports
The extension comes amid continuing global trade and logistics uncertainties
items.exam: RoDTEP; export promotion; WTO compatibility; embedded taxes and duties; India’s foreign trade policy.

items.en: RBI raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50% (MPC, 5–7 Oct 2026)
items.te: రెపో రేటును 25 బేసిస్ పాయింట్లు పెంచి 5.50%కు చేర్చిన ఆర్‌బీఐ
points: The Monetary Policy Committee met on 5–7 October 2026 under Governor Sanjay Malhotra and raised the repo rate from 5.25% to 5.50%.
The six-member MPC voted unanimously; the stance moved from neutral to "calibrated tightening".
SDF rate is now 5.25%; MSF rate and Bank Rate are 5.75%.
It is the first repo rate hike since February 2023, when the rate went to 6.50%.
items.exam: MPC under Section 45ZB of the RBI Act, 1934 (six members, Governor has a casting vote); repo, SDF, MSF and Bank Rate; a rate hike is used to control inflation.

items.en: ISRO establishes Advanced Radar Research Facility at ISTRAC
items.te: ఇస్రో ISTRACలో అడ్వాన్స్‌డ్ రాడార్ రీసెర్చ్ ఫెసిలిటీని ఏర్పాటు చేస్తోంది
points: ISRO’s ISTRAC Advanced Radar Research Facility (IARRF) is being established as a multidisciplinary radar research platform
The facility will support ionospheric and atmospheric science, weather monitoring, cloud studies and space-weather research
Radar applications can improve flash-flood warnings, thunderstorm and lightning nowcasting, aviation safety and agricultural advisories
The facility will also support universities, start-ups, industry and young scientists in indigenous radar technology development
items.exam: ISRO; ISTRAC; radar technology; ionosphere; space weather; weather forecasting; disaster management applications.

items.en: Special Campaign 6 focuses on Swachhata and citizen-centric governance
items.te: స్పెషల్ క్యాంపెయిన్ 6 ద్వారా పరిశుభ్రత, పెండెన్సీ తగ్గింపు మరియు పౌర సేవల బలోపేతం
points: Special Campaign 6 is being implemented from 2 October to 31 October 2026
The campaign focuses on cleanliness, reducing pendency and strengthening citizen-centric service delivery
Government departments are undertaking record management, cleanliness drives and administrative efficiency measures
The campaign also promotes better disposal and scientific management of e-waste
items.exam: Good Governance; citizen-centric administration; Swachhata; pendency reduction; administrative reforms; e-waste management.

items.en: Two Great Indian Bustards released into the wild in Rajasthan
items.te: రాజస్థాన్‌లో రెండు గ్రేట్ ఇండియన్ బస్టార్డ్స్‌ను అడవిలోకి విడుదల
points: Two captive-bred male Great Indian Bustards were released at Desert National Park, Jaisalmer on 4 October 2026
The release marks a transition from captive breeding towards rewilding and population recovery
The programme is being implemented through collaboration among MoEFCC, Rajasthan Forest Department and Wildlife Institute of India
The Great Indian Bustard is Critically Endangered and faces major threats including habitat loss and power-line collisions
items.exam: Great Indian Bustard; IUCN Red List; Desert National Park; Wildlife Protection Act; species recovery and conservation breeding.

items.en: India pushes WTO-compliant solutions to global trade distortions at G20
items.te: జీ20 వాణిజ్య మంత్రుల సమావేశంలో WTO నియమాలకు అనుగుణమైన ప్రపంచ వాణిజ్య విధానానికి భారత్ పిలుపు
points: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal participated in the G20 Trade Ministers’ Meeting in Milwaukee, United States
India stressed evidence-based and WTO-consistent measures to correct global trade distortions
India highlighted the Most-Favoured-Nation principle and the importance of a rules-based multilateral trading system
India also supported adequate policy space and special treatment for developing countries
items.exam: G20; WTO; Most-Favoured-Nation principle; anti-dumping; developing-country policy space; rules-based multilateral trading system.

items.en: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2026 awarded for optogenetics research
items.te: ఆప్టోజెనెటిక్స్ పరిశోధనకు 2026 నోబెల్ ఫిజియాలజీ లేదా మెడిసిన్ బహుమతి
points: Karl Deisseroth, Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel received the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
They were honoured for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics
Optogenetics uses light-sensitive proteins to control the activity of specific nerve cells
The research has transformed neuroscience by enabling precise study of neural circuits and brain functions
items.exam: Nobel Prize; optogenetics; ion channels; neuroscience; applications in neurological research and brain disorders.

items.en: India finishes Asian Games 2026 campaign with major gold-medal performances
items.te: 2026 ఆసియా క్రీడల్లో భారత్‌కు క్రికెట్, హాకీ, ఆర్చరీ సహా పలు స్వర్ణాలు
points: India retained the Asian Games men’s cricket gold medal
India retained the men’s hockey gold after defeating Malaysia 5–1
India’s women’s hockey team won Asian Games gold after a gap of more than four decades
Kumkum Anil Mohod won historic gold in women’s recurve individual archery, while Pranavi Sharath Urs won women’s individual golf gold
items.exam: Aichi–Nagoya Asian Games 2026; Asian Games; hockey; archery; golf; India’s Olympic qualification pathway for Los Angeles 2028.

items.en: RBI policy rates before the October MPC: Repo 5.25%, CRR 3% and SLR 18%
items.te: అక్టోబర్ MPCకి ముందు ఆర్‌బీఐ పాలసీ రేట్లు: రెపో 5.25%, CRR 3%, SLR 18%
points: RBI’s policy repo rate stands at 5.25% as of 5 October 2026
Standing Deposit Facility rate is 5.00% and Marginal Standing Facility rate is 5.50%
Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) is 3.00% and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) is 18.00%
The RBI is responsible for monetary policy, banking regulation and maintaining financial stability
Update: on 7 October 2026 the MPC raised the repo rate to 5.50% (SDF 5.25%, MSF 5.75%).
items.exam: Repo Rate; SDF; MSF; CRR; SLR; Monetary Policy Committee (MPC); inflation and liquidity management.

items.en: UPSC completes 100 years
items.te: UPSCకి 100 ఏళ్లు పూర్తి
points: Set up on 1 October 1926 as the Public Service Commission under the Government of India Act, 1919
Present three-stage exam (Prelims–Mains–Interview) dates from 1979
PM called for shorter exam cycles 'without lowering the bar'
items.exam: Articles 315–323 (Part XIV); Lee Commission (1924) recommended its creation.

items.en: Green Energy Corridor Phase-III worth ₹1,86,405 crore
items.te: ₹1,86,405 కోట్లతో గ్రీన్ ఎనర్జీ కారిడార్ ఫేజ్-III
points: To evacuate 135 GW of renewable power
Includes 50 GWh of Battery Energy Storage Systems — a first for the scheme
Central support: ₹54,082 crore (about 29% of the outlay)
items.exam: Link to India's 500 GW non-fossil capacity target by 2030; AP is a major RE state.

items.en: Southwest monsoon 2026 ends 12.6% below normal
items.te: 2026 నైరుతి రుతుపవనాలు సాధారణం కంటే 12.6% తక్కువ
points: 759.4 mm rainfall against a normal of 868.6 mm
Driest monsoon since 2015
East & Northeast India recorded their driest season since records began in 1901; strong El Niño cited
items.exam: El Niño vs La Niña, IOD; IMD's 'deficient' category is below 90% of LPA.

items.en: Gandak floods: record water release breaches embankments in Bihar
items.te: గండక్ వరదలు: బిహార్‌లో కట్టలు తెగాయి
points: Record 5.43 lakh cusecs released from Valmikinagar barrage on 28 September
Three embankments breached in West Champaran district
About 73% of Bihar's area is flood-prone — highest among states
items.exam: Gandak is a left-bank tributary of the Ganga rising in Nepal.

items.en: Captive-bred Great Indian Bustards to be released in Desert National Park
items.te: డెజర్ట్ నేషనల్ పార్క్‌లో బట్టమేక పక్షుల విడుదల
points: Two captive-bred males to be released around 4 October at Jaisalmer, Rajasthan
Wild population about 140 birds, ~130 in Rajasthan
Collisions with power lines are the leading cause of death
items.exam: IUCN: Critically Endangered; Schedule I of the Wildlife (Protection) Act; state bird of Rajasthan.

items.en: Poompuhar underwater dig finds West Asian jar fragments
items.te: పూంపుహార్ సముద్రగర్భ తవ్వకాల్లో పశ్చిమాసియా జాడీ ముక్కలు
points: Torpedo-jar fragments found 1.8–2.2 km offshore at 10–12 m depth
Poompuhar (Kaveripattinam) was a Sangam-era port at the Kaveri's mouth
Tamil text Pattinappalai describes its busy trade
items.exam: Sangam-age ports: Poompuhar (Cholas), Korkai (Pandyas), Muziris (Cheras).

items.en: BrahMos exports set to cross $600 million
items.te: బ్రహ్మోస్ ఎగుమతులు $600 మిలియన్ దాటనున్నాయి
points: Export deals linked to the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia
The Philippines has already received deliveries
items.exam: BrahMos: India–Russia JV, supersonic cruise missile; named after Brahmaputra and Moskva rivers.

items.en: First tigress released into Buxa Tiger Reserve, West Bengal
items.te: పశ్చిమ బెంగాల్‌లోని బక్సా టైగర్ రిజర్వ్‌లో తొలి పులి విడుదల
points: A three-year-old Royal Bengal tigress (150 kg) released on 2 October 2026
Part of efforts to restore tigers in Buxa
items.exam: Tiger reserves are notified under the Wildlife (Protection) Act; NTCA oversees Project Tiger.

items.en: Survey: 63% of cybercrime victims unhappy with police response
items.te: సర్వే: 63% సైబర్ నేర బాధితులు పోలీసు స్పందనపై అసంతృప్తి
points: Only 29% were attended to within one hour
23% had to visit five or more times to file a complaint
items.exam: Cybercrime helpline 1930; portal cybercrime.gov.in; I4C under the Home Ministry.

items.en: Popped makhana exported from Purnea, Bihar to Greece
items.te: బిహార్ పూర్ణియా నుండి గ్రీస్‌కు మఖానా ఎగుమతి
points: One metric tonne consignment facilitated by APEDA
items.exam: Mithila Makhana has a GI tag; APEDA works under the Commerce Ministry.

items.en: Pan-IIT AP Summit 2026 held in Vijayawada to plan AP as a global tech hub
items.te: విజయవాడలో పాన్-IIT ఏపీ సమ్మిట్ 2026 — ఏపీని గ్లోబల్ టెక్ హబ్‌గా మార్చే ప్రణాళిక
points: Held on 3 October 2026 in Vijayawada; addressed by CM N. Chandrababu Naidu
Aim: a blueprint for 'Swarna Andhra 2047' and 'Viksit Bharat 2047'
Focus sectors: AI, quantum computing, deep tech, space technology and clean energy
items.exam: AP Group 1/2: Swarna Andhra 2047 vision, AP's emerging-tech policies (Amaravati Quantum Valley).

items.en: Cabinet raises MSP for Rabi crops for marketing season 2027–28
items.te: 2027–28 రబీ పంటలకు కనీస మద్దతు ధర పెంపు
points: Approved by the Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs (CCEA)
Wheat MSP up ₹25 to ₹2,610 per quintal
Highest hike for safflower: up ₹675 to ₹7,215 per quintal
Margin over cost of production: 50% to 106%

items.en: Small savings interest rates unchanged for Oct–Dec 2026 quarter
items.te: అక్టోబర్–డిసెంబర్ 2026 త్రైమాసికానికి చిన్న పొదుపు వడ్డీ రేట్లు యథాతథం
points: Applies to Q3 FY27 (1 Oct – 31 Dec 2026)
14th consecutive quarter with no change
Last revised in Q4 FY24
items.exam: Schemes: PPF, SSY, NSC, SCSS, KVP — rates notified quarterly by the Finance Ministry.

items.en: National Coastal Mission 2.0 approved with ₹767 crore
items.te: ₹767 కోట్లతో జాతీయ తీర మిషన్ 2.0

Runs till 2030–31

items.en: PRAGATI-50: 50 role-model sanitation cities under SBM-Urban 2.0
items.te: PRAGATI-50: స్వచ్ఛ భారత్ మిషన్-అర్బన్ 2.0 కింద 50 మోడల్ పారిశుద్ధ్య నగరాలు

50 cities across 24 states
Includes a Swachh Bharat Test Bed at Durgapur, West Bengal
items.exam: SBM-U 2.0 (2021–26): garbage-free cities, used water management.

items.en: Windfall tax on diesel and ATF exports cut from 1 October
items.te: డీజిల్, ATF ఎగుమతులపై విండ్‌ఫాల్ పన్ను తగ్గింపు
points: Diesel export duty: ₹20 → ₹16 per litre
ATF export duty: ₹15 → ₹10.5 per litre
Petrol duty kept at ₹0.5 per litre; effective 1 October 2026
items.exam: Windfall tax = levy on unusually high profits from external events (e.g., crude price spikes).

items.en: 2nd ASEAN–India Maritime Exercise at Subic Bay, Philippines
items.te: ఫిలిప్పీన్స్‌లోని సుబిక్ బే వద్ద 2వ ఆసియాన్–ఇండియా సముద్ర విన్యాసం
points: Indian Navy ships: INS Sahyadri and INS Kulish

items.exam: Act East Policy; India–Philippines ties (BrahMos export).

items.en: Appointments: Morocco gets first woman PM; new heads at Kotak Bank and New India Assurance

Kotak Mahindra Bank: Anup Kumar Saha to be MD & CEO from 1 January 2027
New India Assurance: Lavanya R Mundayur appointed CMD till 31 May 2029

points: 5th edition, 28–31 January 2027

75,000+ professionals and 700+ international exhibitors expected
items.exam: Organised with the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas.

items.te: గిరిజన సాంస్కృతిక వారసత్వ డిజిటలీకరణకు గిరిజన వ్యవహారాల శాఖ–IGNCA ఒప్పందం

items.en: Cabinet clears ₹23,731 crore GOBARdhan scheme for compressed biogas
items.te: కంప్రెస్డ్ బయోగ్యాస్ కోసం ₹23,731 కోట్ల గోబర్‌ధన్ పథకం

Central Sector Scheme for 10 years: FY 2026–27 to FY 2035–36
Benchmark price ₹2,110 per MMBtu; Compressed Biogas Obligation starts at 3% in FY 2026–27

items.exam: Prelims: scheme type, tenure, outlay. Mains GS-III: waste-to-energy and rural income.

Built by Digital India BHASHINI Division with the Comptroller and Auditor General
Human-in-the-loop review with data sovereignty safeguards

Ankush Panghal — men's 80 kg boxing gold
Parveen Hooda — women's 65 kg gold, beat Chen Nien-Chen (Chinese Taipei)
India's first-ever Asian Games gold in women's recurve team archery
